### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

## For labeling with added value

HERMA is a **leading European innovator** in the development and manufacture of sustainable
**adhesive materials**, a sought-after specialist in efficient **labeling solutions**, and a
technology leader in **labelers** and **labeling machines**. Founded in 1906, HERMA remains
family-owned and, with five foreign subsidiaries, is focused on long-term, internationally
successful corporate development.

### Self-adhesive Material

HERMA's "Self-adhesive Material" division offers label materials ([papers ][51]and [films][52]),
[adhesives ][53]and [release liners][54] combined to form [adhesive materials][55] for a wide range
of industries. With these numerous self-adhesive materials, labels can be produced for a wide
variety of labeling applications.

[HERMA Self-adhesive Material][56]

[Self-adhesive material from HERMA]

### Labels for office and home

In addition to labels for office, retail and logistics, the HERMA "Office & Home" area also offers a
wide range of craft and school supplies. [Folders][57], [book covers][58], [stickers ][59]as well as
our [mounting][60] and [archiving][61] systems (photo) can be used at home as well as in the office
or [school][62]. Our labels can also be used in a variety of ways, e.g.:
* In the office as [file labels][63]
* As an [address label][64] for sending letters and parcels
* Seal and security labels
* Pre-printed labels for usage as signs, also in outdoor environment

With HERMA labels for office and home, you are equipped for every application.

Design your labels - simply professional. With our free software [Label Assistant Online][65] or our
[Word templates][66] you can easily and quickly design and print your labels individually with laser
and inkjet printers.

technology leader in **labelers** and **labeling machines**. Founded in 1906, HERMA remains
family-owned and, with five foreign subsidiaries, is focused on long-term, internationally
successful corporate development.

### Self-adhesive Material

HERMA's "Self-adhesive Material" division offers label materials ([papers ][51]and [films][52]),
[adhesives ][53]and [release liners][54] combined to form [adhesive materials][55] for a wide range
of industries. With these numerous self-adhesive materials, labels can be produced for a wide
variety of labeling applications.

[HERMA Self-adhesive Material][56]

[Self-adhesive material from HERMA]

### Labels for office and home

In addition to labels for office, retail and logistics, the HERMA "Office & Home" area also offers a
wide range of craft and school supplies. [Folders][57], [book covers][58], [stickers ][59]as well as
our [mounting][60] and [archiving][61] systems (photo) can be used at home as well as in the office
or [school][62]. Our labels can also be used in a variety of ways, e.g.:
* In the office as [file labels][63]
* As an [address label][64] for sending letters and parcels
* Seal and security labels
* Pre-printed labels for usage as signs, also in outdoor environment

With HERMA labels for office and home, you are equipped for every application.

Design your labels - simply professional. With our free software [Label Assistant Online][65] or our
[Word templates][66] you can easily and quickly design and print your labels individually with laser
and inkjet printers.

[HERMA Office and Home][67]

[Labels for the Office and Home from HERMA]

### Labels for large quantities and the industry

Custom-made products for industrial applications are available in the HERMA "[Labels][68]" section.
Whether [product presentation][69], [shipping labels][70], [barcode labels][71], [hazardous material
labels][72] and [sealing labels][73] or labels that adhere to difficult surfaces: HERMA industrial
labels are just as diverse and developed for a wide variety of applications.

We manufacture tailor-made labels for you in special designs, in economical quantities, unprinted or
in various print qualities, as [labels on rolls][74], [sheet labels][75] and [fanfolded labels][76].

[HERMA Labels][77]

[HERMA Online-Shop for industrial labels][78]

#### **NEW: Configure and order customised printed roll labels online!**

With our online label configurator, you can easily configure your digitally printed roll labels and
order them online immediately. Label size as required, made of paper or film, with protective
coating or lamination if required. Just a few clicks to the price, upload your print data and send
your order.

[**Start the Label Configurator now!**][79]

### Labelers and labeling machines

HERMA is a leading manufacturer of label applicators and labeling machines with the highest
precision, performance and flexibility. Whether [fully automatic labeling machines][80],
[semi-automatic machines ][81]or [print & apply systems][82], HERMA offers solutions for a wide
range of labeling applications in the machinery sector. With the aid of different labeling types,
such as top, bottom, side, wrap-around or seal labeling, a wide variety of shapes and products can
be reliably and accurately provided with one or more labels.

Thanks to the modular design of HERMA labeling machines, even the most individual labeling
requirements can be met.

## RELATED PRODUCT BRANDS

[Labeling & Coding logo]
As a leading single source provider of high-quality labeling, coding, and marking systems, ProMach
designs, manufactures, and integrates custom identification solutions to ensure peak operational
efficiency. With advanced systems for applications in primary and secondary packaging, as well as
distribution and fulfillment environments, our solutions provide accurate labeling and coding on
virtually every substrate in every market.

## EXPLORE OTHER PROMACH BUSINESS LINES

ProMach is your partner from start to finish. Our product brands are grouped into distinct business
lines that make the most sense to our customers, covering every function of the production line:
Filling, Bottling & Capping, Decorative Labeling, Flexibles & Trays, Pharma, Handling & Sterilizing,
Labeling & Coding, Robotics & End of Line, and Systems & Integration.

**October 11-14 | Nashville, TN**

Join corrugated and folding carton leaders for the industry’s most forward-looking event of the

operate stronger.

* Order Processing

[Learn more][134]

Manage your label printing business from order entry to invoice, built from the ground up for narrow
web flexo and digital label printers.

* Sheet feeder extensibility
* Order management

* Shipping

[Learn more][136]

solution to a persistent problem. Now as a Resource Label Group Company, our focus continues to be
to help eliminate label waste that is created within our industry and to help divert any label waste

## We supply high-performance label stock for printers worldwide

Our label materials are part of UPM Adhesive Materials. As one of the leading suppliers of
self-adhesive label stock globally, we offer you consistently high-quality label materials that
bring together performance and sustainability.

Whether you’re working with branded food packaging labels, durable industrial solutions or the
informative demands of logistics labeling, we deliver the right label material for you.

We are dedicated to your success and ready to connect with your ambition.

#### High-quality materials and adhesive expertise

#### Reliable service and collaboration

#### Innovative solutions for growing end-uses

### UPM Raflatac^{™}

[Discover the UPM Raflatac^{™} difference][3]
 

[Already a customer? Order in MyRaflatac][4]

[Send us an inquiry][5]

## UPM’s label material offering

Your success depends on reliable adhesive material performance. That is why we offer an extensive
range of pressure sensitive label stock for every end use and market segment. At the core is the
[**UPM Raflatac™**][6] line of premium label materials, the name you trust for quality, performance
and sustainability innovation across end uses. Supported by adhesive expertise, advanced materials
science and expert services, our premium offering helps you deliver consistent, reliable results for
your customers.

To complement these premium materials, [**UPM Intercoat™**][7] label materials provide
cost-competitive, dependable bulk solutions that balance performance and supply reliability with
cost efficiency. Together, UPM Raflatac™ and UPM Intercoat™ give you a full spectrum of label
material options so you can choose the right fit for every application, every customer and every
market segment. 

### Paper labels
* Coated and uncoated paper faces
* Gloss, matt and textured finishes
* White and colored papers
* Specialty papers

[Discover more][8]

### Film labels
* PP labels
* PE labels
* PET labels
* PVC labels

[Discover more][9]

### Adhesives
* Permanent
* Removable
* Wash-off

[Discover more][10]

### Direct thermal linerless labels
* Paper and film DT linerless labels
* DT linerless wash off labels

[Discover more][11]

### Sustainable label materials
* PCR labels
* Wash off labels
* Certified label materials
* Linerless labels

[Discover more][12]

### Sustainability services
* **Label Life**: Make more sustainable label choices with Label Life
* **RafCycle™**: Recycle label liner waste

[Discover more][13]

[Are you a customer? Order in MyRaflatac][14]

## Labels by industry

Our high-quality label products cater to various and growing end-uses. Whether you’re a printer,
designer or a brand, you can trust our materials to meet your needs.

We’re proud to collaborate with leading printing and converting partners – take a look at some of
the companies we work with and what they have to say about working with UPM Adhesive Materials.

*“We partner with UPM Adhesive Materials because they don’t just supply materials – they are
interested in our success. Their ability to listen, respond, and bring new ideas to the table helps
us navigate the challenges of narrow web flexo and digital printing. By giving us reliable
substrates and genuine collaboration, they free us to focus on what we do best: delivering products
that exceed our customers’ expectations.”*

– **Jennifer Duckworth**, Procurement Manager

*“Our partnership with UPM Adhesive Materials is built on trust, innovation, and a shared commitment
to quality – a relationship that continues to strengthen and support our growth at Lattice Labels.”*

– **Tony Clifton**, Managing Director

*“UPM Adhesive Materials is a fantastic partner for our business. Their label materials are
reliable, high quality, and a great fit for our products. What really sets them apart is the support
we get. Whether it’s helping us choose the right material or troubleshooting an issue, they’re
always on it and easy to work with. Between the product quality and the level of service we get, UPM
Adhesive Materials has earned our trust.”*

– **Miranda Harrington**, General Manager

*“UPM is an outstanding partner for Abbott Label, consistently delivering excellent
service and high-quality products. Their reliability and commitment to supporting our business gives
us the confidence to meet our customers’ needs every day. We truly value UPM as a supplier we can
always count on.”*

– **John Abbott**, President

range of pressure sensitive label stock for every end use and market segment. At the core is the

# Adhesivas Ibi
# Fábrica de etiquetas

"Donde la excelencia se pega"

Etiquetas para los 365 días del año

## Servicios como fabricantes
## de etiquetas adhesivas

Descubre nuestra gama variada de sistemas de impresión diseñados para brindarte resultados
excepcionales. Ya sea que necesites imprimir pocas o muchas etiquetas, con diferentes opciones de
tintas, especificaciones personalizadas o acabados exclusivos, contamos con recursos técnicos y un
equipo especializado para proporcionarte un servicio premium. Confía en nosotros para llevar tus
impresiones al siguiente nivel.

### Impresión
### digital

Esta técnica de impresión es perfecta para la producción de etiquetas personalizadas. Esta técnica
es Ideal para tiradas cortas, mercados específicos o campañas especiales. 

[ Descubre más ][46]

### Impresión
### offset

Si buscas un etiquetado versátil y en grandes cantidades, esta técnica es la idónea para tu empresa.
Podemos imprimir en materiales lisos, rugosos, porosos, verjurados, etcétera.  

[ Descubre más ][47]

### Flexografía

La flexografía es una de las técnicas de producción de etiquetas más utilizada. Nos permite hacer
medias y largas tiradas con acabados plastificados, stamping frío, impresión en el adhesivo…  

[ Descubre más ][48]

### Serigrafía

Creamos etiquetas adhesivas personalizadas, llamativas y exclusivas en todo tipo de material con
acabados en braile, glitter, iridiscentes, termocromáticos, volugraf y mucho más.  

[ Descubre más ][49]

## Sectores para los que fabricamos
## etiquetas adhesivas

Transmite la calidad y lo valores de tu producto a través de su etiqueta. Para ello, en Adhesivas
Ibi imprimimos etiquetas adhesivas para una amplia variedad de sectores.  

### Botellería

En el sector de la botellería existen múltiples productos variados que requieren una personalización
específica y, es necesario resaltar el valor de la marca y el atractivo visual del producto para
llamar la atención de los consumidores.
[ SABER MÁS ][50]

### Alimentación

La industria alimentaria requiere un proceso de etiquetado y diseño específico que cumpla con una
serie de normativas concretas y la marca sea reconocida por sus propiedades e ingredientes.
[ SABER MÁS ][51]

### Cosmética

El etiquetado de productos pertenecientes al sector cosmético debe poner en alza el atractivo visual
y la imagen del producto en cuestión. Nuestras etiquetas están pensadas específicamente para cada
artículo determinado resaltando todas sus cualidades estéticas.
[ SABER MÁS ][52]

### Higiene y menaje

Este tipo de productos necesitan un etiquetado capaz de resistir condiciones extremas de cambios de
temperatura y exposición a químicos, por lo que nuestro compromiso es el de elaborar unas etiquetas
adhesivas que cumplan con los más altos estándares de calidad y durabilidad.
[ SABER MÁS ][53]

### Aceites y Vinagres

Además de la necesidad de unas etiquetas resistentes a la humedad y a los líquidos, el sector del
aceite y del vinagre requiere un etiquetado excelente que priorice la sutileza y pureza de estos
productos.
[ SABER MÁS ][54]

Si no te ven, no existes. Las etiquetas de tus productos son clave para llamar la atención del
usuario.

Etiquetas plastificadas

Etiquetas con relieve

Etiquetas con olor

Etiquetas barnizadas

En Adhesivas Ibi contamos con certificación ISO 9001, lo que nos hace destacar y garantizar un
proceso de calidad y profesional en todo momento. Al imprimir las etiquetas adhesivas de tu producto
con nosotros podrás beneficiarte de un proceso de etiquetado totalmente personalizado para que el
resultado final se adapte a tus necesidades y expectativas, así como un asesoramiento rápido y
eficaz para garantizar que tus productos destacan en el mercado.

## FAQS sobre nuestras
## etiquetas adhesivas industriales personalizadas

¿Qué tipo de etiquetas adhesivas fabrican en Adhesivas Ibi?
Fabricamos etiquetas adhesivas en bobina adaptadas a diversos sectores industriales como
alimentación, cosmética, química, automoción, limpieza y logística. Nuestras soluciones combinan
funcionalidad técnica con un acabado visual de alta calidad, ajustándose a las exigencias de cada
cliente.
¿Qué materiales utilizan para la fabricación de etiquetas?
Utilizamos una amplia gama de materiales, como papel, polipropileno (PP), polietileno (PE), térmico
y sustratos especiales. Ofrecemos acabados como stamping metálico, relieve, barnices selectivos,
plastificados brillo o mate, y otras técnicas de embellecimiento o protección.
¿Ofrecen etiquetas sostenibles o ecológicas?
Sí, disponemos de opciones de [etiquetado fabricadas con materiales sostenibles y reciclables][58],
ideales para empresas que apuestan por la responsabilidad medioambiental y la economía circular.
¿Pueden fabricar etiquetas personalizadas según mi producto?
Por supuesto. Diseñamos etiquetas 100 % personalizadas en cuanto a tamaño, forma, colores, tipo de
adhesivo, resistencia al entorno y requisitos normativos específicos.
¿Cuál es el proceso de fabricación en Adhesivas Ibi?
Nuestro proceso incluye asesoramiento técnico inicial, selección de materiales adecuados, diseño
gráfico personalizado, pruebas de calidad y producción final en nuestras instalaciones certificadas
en Ibi (Alicante).
¿Qué ventajas ofrece Adhesivas Ibi frente a otras empresas del sector?
Destacamos por nuestro servicio personalizado, más de 40 años de experiencia, tecnología de
impresión avanzada, soluciones sostenibles y un riguroso sistema de control de calidad en todos los
procesos.
¿Dónde se fabrican sus etiquetas?
Todas nuestras etiquetas se diseñan, imprimen y finalizan en nuestras propias instalaciones en Ibi
(Alicante), bajo controles internos que garantizan calidad, trazabilidad y cumplimiento de
normativas.
¿Qué sectores industriales trabajan con ustedes?
Colaboramos con empresas líderes en sectores como alimentación, cosmética, limpieza del hogar e
industrial, automoción, químico, farmacéutico, logístico y retail.
¿Pueden gestionar pedidos de gran volumen?
Sí, disponemos de capacidad tecnológica y logística para fabricar grandes volúmenes sin comprometer
calidad ni tiempos de entrega.
¿Cómo puedo solicitar un presupuesto?
Puedes contactarnos a través del formulario de nuestra web o llamarnos directamente. Te ofreceremos
asesoramiento personalizado y un presupuesto ajustado a tus necesidades específicas.
¿Qué tecnologías utilizan para la impresión?
Trabajamos principalmente con impresión flexográfica de alta definición, ideal para tiradas medianas
y grandes, sobre múltiples soportes. También integramos tecnologías complementarias para acabados
especiales.
¿Ofrecen asesoramiento técnico sobre el tipo de etiqueta más adecuado?
Sí, brindamos consultoría técnica para seleccionar la etiqueta más eficiente según su aplicación,

El etiquetado de productos pertenecientes al sector cosmético debe poner en alza el atractivo visual
y la imagen del producto en cuestión. Nuestras etiquetas están pensadas específicamente para cada
artículo determinado resaltando todas sus cualidades estéticas.

## FAQS sobre nuestras
## etiquetas adhesivas industriales personalizadas

¿Qué tipo de etiquetas adhesivas fabrican en Adhesivas Ibi?
Fabricamos etiquetas adhesivas en bobina adaptadas a diversos sectores industriales como
alimentación, cosmética, química, automoción, limpieza y logística. Nuestras soluciones combinan
funcionalidad técnica con un acabado visual de alta calidad, ajustándose a las exigencias de cada
cliente.
¿Qué materiales utilizan para la fabricación de etiquetas?
Utilizamos una amplia gama de materiales, como papel, polipropileno (PP), polietileno (PE), térmico
y sustratos especiales. Ofrecemos acabados como stamping metálico, relieve, barnices selectivos,
plastificados brillo o mate, y otras técnicas de embellecimiento o protección.
¿Ofrecen etiquetas sostenibles o ecológicas?
Sí, disponemos de opciones de [etiquetado fabricadas con materiales sostenibles y reciclables][58],
ideales para empresas que apuestan por la responsabilidad medioambiental y la economía circular.
¿Pueden fabricar etiquetas personalizadas según mi producto?
Por supuesto. Diseñamos etiquetas 100 % personalizadas en cuanto a tamaño, forma, colores, tipo de
adhesivo, resistencia al entorno y requisitos normativos específicos.
¿Cuál es el proceso de fabricación en Adhesivas Ibi?
Nuestro proceso incluye asesoramiento técnico inicial, selección de materiales adecuados, diseño
gráfico personalizado, pruebas de calidad y producción final en nuestras instalaciones certificadas
en Ibi (Alicante).
¿Qué ventajas ofrece Adhesivas Ibi frente a otras empresas del sector?
Destacamos por nuestro servicio personalizado, más de 40 años de experiencia, tecnología de
impresión avanzada, soluciones sostenibles y un riguroso sistema de control de calidad en todos los
procesos.
¿Dónde se fabrican sus etiquetas?
Todas nuestras etiquetas se diseñan, imprimen y finalizan en nuestras propias instalaciones en Ibi
(Alicante), bajo controles internos que garantizan calidad, trazabilidad y cumplimiento de
normativas.
¿Qué sectores industriales trabajan con ustedes?
Colaboramos con empresas líderes en sectores como alimentación, cosmética, limpieza del hogar e
industrial, automoción, químico, farmacéutico, logístico y retail.
¿Pueden gestionar pedidos de gran volumen?
Sí, disponemos de capacidad tecnológica y logística para fabricar grandes volúmenes sin comprometer
calidad ni tiempos de entrega.
¿Cómo puedo solicitar un presupuesto?
Puedes contactarnos a través del formulario de nuestra web o llamarnos directamente. Te ofreceremos
asesoramiento personalizado y un presupuesto ajustado a tus necesidades específicas.
¿Qué tecnologías utilizan para la impresión?
Trabajamos principalmente con impresión flexográfica de alta definición, ideal para tiradas medianas

especiales.

## Experience Long-Lasting Customized Label Solutions

**When it comes to finding the right label for your business,*** *there’s no one-size-fits-all
solution. That’s why we focus on creating customized, long-lasting labels that work where others
fail. Starting with a free sample, we can take your vision and make adjustments so you get a label
that stands the test of the environment and stays true to its overall function.

**************************Built-In Quality Assurance for Every Label**************************

**We take pride in our rigorous quality assurance measures that ensure your labels meet the highest
standards…**

****Every label we produce goes through multiple checks across various departments to guarantee
durability, legibility, and accuracy. Our quality coordinator monitors each step of the process,
making sure your custom labels are properly inspected, packaged, and protected for safe transit.
This commitment to quality ensures that your labels arrive ready for immediate use, with
sustainability and precision always in mind.****

********Personal Interactions, Personalized Labels********

**At EIM, we know that no two facilities are the same, which is why we offer customized labeling
solutions designed to meet your exact specifications.**

**But what really sets us apart is the personal touch. With The Label Experts, you’ll never have to
navigate an automated system–every call and inquiry during business hours is answered by a real team
member, ready to help. This courtesy is extended to our free printing support for our label printers
as well.**

## Discover Our *Made-to-Order* Label
## Capabilities for Your Industry

We specialize in custom labels of all shapes and sizes that work in challenging environments across
multiple industries. Whether your business is in healthcare, manufacturing, or beyond, we tailor our
label-making processes to your specific needs.

[[White and blue lab beakers inside orange circle icon.][White and blue lab beakers inside orange
circle icon.]][80]

### [Laboratory and Healthcare][81]

Our carefully crafted, high-quality labels withstand the demands of laboratory and healthcare
environments, ensuring critical information remains visible regardless of label size, and intact
even under harsh conditions.

[[White and blue industrial factory inside orange circle icon.][White and blue industrial factory
inside orange circle icon.]][82]

### [Industrial and Manufacturing][83]

Industrial environments can be tough on labels, but our products are designed to endure, providing
essential information without fading, peeling, or wearing down over time.

[[White and blue printed asset label inside orange circle icon.][White and blue printed asset label
inside orange circle icon.]][84]

### **[Asset and Inventory][85]**

Efficiently track and manage your assets and inventory with our durable and reliable custom barcode
labels, designed to last in high-use environments.

[[White and blue warehouse forklift inside orange circle icon.][White and blue warehouse forklift
inside orange circle icon.]][86]

### [Warehouse][87]

In fast-paced warehouse settings, having labels that are easy to scan is essential. Our solutions
help you maintain smooth operations with labels that stick and stay legible.

## Find Solutions that Bind Function With Visibility and Vibrancy

With EIM’s quality assurance measures and customizable capabilities*,* you can be confident that
your labels will hold up even under the harshest conditions.

[**Get My Free Sample**][88]

## Explore What Makes Us The Label Experts

At EIM, quality assurance is at the heart of everything we do. From the initial design to the final
product, we conduct thorough checks at every stage to ensure your labels meet our high standards.
Our dedicated quality coordinator monitors the production process closely, ensuring that every label
is consistent and ready for use.

[Learn About Us][89]

## See What Our Satisfied Customers Are Saying

We’re proud of our speedy response times and the relationships we’ve built with our customers. Hear
directly from them about how our service, quality, and responsiveness have helped streamline their
operations and improve their label usage.


[Read Our Reviews][90]

## Experience Long-Lasting Customized Label Solutions

**When it comes to finding the right label for your business,*** *there’s no one-size-fits-all
solution. That’s why we focus on creating customized, long-lasting labels that work where others
fail. Starting with a free sample, we can take your vision and make adjustments so you get a label
that stands the test of the environment and stays true to its overall function.

**************************Built-In Quality Assurance for Every Label**************************

**We take pride in our rigorous quality assurance measures that ensure your labels meet the highest
standards…**

****Every label we produce goes through multiple checks across various departments to guarantee
durability, legibility, and accuracy. Our quality coordinator monitors each step of the process,
making sure your custom labels are properly inspected, packaged, and protected for safe transit.
This commitment to quality ensures that your labels arrive ready for immediate use, with
sustainability and precision always in mind.****

********Personal Interactions, Personalized Labels********

**At EIM, we know that no two facilities are the same, which is why we offer customized labeling
solutions designed to meet your exact specifications.**

**But what really sets us apart is the personal touch. With The Label Experts, you’ll never have to
navigate an automated system–every call and inquiry during business hours is answered by a real team
member, ready to help. This courtesy is extended to our free printing support for our label printers
as well.**

## Discover Our *Made-to-Order* Label
## Capabilities for Your Industry

We specialize in custom labels of all shapes and sizes that work in challenging environments across
multiple industries. Whether your business is in healthcare, manufacturing, or beyond, we tailor our
label-making processes to your specific needs.

[[White and blue lab beakers inside orange circle icon.][White and blue lab beakers inside orange
circle icon.]][80]

### [Laboratory and Healthcare][81]

Our carefully crafted, high-quality labels withstand the demands of laboratory and healthcare
environments, ensuring critical information remains visible regardless of label size, and intact
even under harsh conditions.

[[White and blue industrial factory inside orange circle icon.][White and blue industrial factory
inside orange circle icon.]][82]

### [Industrial and Manufacturing][83]

Industrial environments can be tough on labels, but our products are designed to endure, providing
essential information without fading, peeling, or wearing down over time.

[[White and blue printed asset label inside orange circle icon.][White and blue printed asset label
inside orange circle icon.]][84]

### **[Asset and Inventory][85]**

Efficiently track and manage your assets and inventory with our durable and reliable custom barcode
labels, designed to last in high-use environments.

[[White and blue warehouse forklift inside orange circle icon.][White and blue warehouse forklift
inside orange circle icon.]][86]

### [Warehouse][87]

In fast-paced warehouse settings, having labels that are easy to scan is essential. Our solutions
help you maintain smooth operations with labels that stick and stay legible.

## Find Solutions that Bind Function With Visibility and Vibrancy

With EIM’s quality assurance measures and customizable capabilities*,* you can be confident that
your labels will hold up even under the harshest conditions.

At EIM, quality assurance is at the heart of everything we do. From the initial design to the final
product, we conduct thorough checks at every stage to ensure your labels meet our high standards.
Our dedicated quality coordinator monitors the production process closely, ensuring that every label
is consistent and ready for use.

We’re proud of our speedy response times and the relationships we’ve built with our customers. Hear

operations and improve their label usage.

# How Glass Speaks to Light^{™}

From the White House to the Burj Khalifa, from the U.S. to Sweden, Germany, and countries all
throughout the world, our glass plays an integral part in some of the most recognizable structures
ever built.

[ Explore projects ][166]

### Bendheim Glass Systems

Precision-engineered, proven, and easy to specify, our wide range of interior and exterior glass
systems offer flexibility and ease of installation for a variety of applications.

[ Explore glass systems ][167]
Z-KISS™ Concealed Interior Glass Cladding System
TurnKey™ Fusion Light Wall System
TurnKey™ Interior Glass Cladding System
Channel Glass Systems
HexaLite™ Glass Cladding
[[Ventilated Glass Facade Systems]][168]Ventilated Glass Facade Systems
[[Decorative Glass Rainscreen Systems]][169]Decorative Glass Rainscreen Systems
[[Bendheim glass canopy system in front of a healthcare facility.]][170]GripGlaze™ Exterior Glass
Systems

### Specialty Glass

Join the ranks of world-renowned architects, interior designers, and global brands who have worked
with us to create breathtaking, timeless expressions of beauty in glass.

[ Explore specialty glass ][171]
Channel Glass
Lamberts® Mouth-Blown Art Glass
[[Glass stair railing by Bendheim with a woven digital printed pattern.]][172]Digitally Printed
Glass
Restoration Glass®
Textured Glass
[[Ceramic Fritted Glass]][173]Ceramic Fritted Glass
[[Mirrored Glass]][174]Mirrored Glass
[[Shower Enclosure Glass]][175]Shower Enclosure Glass

## Visions Realized

You share your ideas and imagination. Together, with the help of our collaborative Design-Assist
process, we turn visions into reality… without compromise. Our only limitations are the laws of
physics.

1

### Design Assist & System Development

To support the design process, early collaboration and visualization help identify potential
challenges, optimize system details, and align design intent with project budgets.

2

### Design Assist & System Development

Provides access to specialized glass knowledge and systems, feasibility, and structural
considerations. Streamline fabrication, reduce costs, and enhance sustainability.

3

### Unique Facades

Create complex facade geometries on tighter budgets, add texture & depth to the facade.

4

### Ease of Installation

No holes through the glass. Compression fittings easily adjust to field conditions speeding the
construction schedule.

5

### Vision Through Custom Solutions

Bendheim’s ventilated glass facade systems protect structures and/or occupants from wind-driven
rain, snow, and ice, while maintaining natural ventilation and daylight advantages.

6

### Visions Realized

Our engineered glass systems provide safety with durable materials, while ensuring ease of
installation through innovative design. They offer aesthetic flexibility, are cost-effective, and
sustainable.

1 of 3

## For decades, our name has been synonymous with glass innovation.

elevator.] ][177]

#### Orange County][178]

For almost 100 years our family’s vision has been to change the world through glass.

Steven Jayson, 3rd Generation

Our only limitations are the laws of physics; everything else is up to your vision and imagination.
We work with the most talented architects and designers in the world, and they know that when they
work with Bendheim that we will deliver their full visions without compromise.

## Founded in NYC. Known the World Over.

### Years of Innovation

Since 1927, the Bendheim family name has been synonymous with glass innovation. Over time we have
developed decades-long relationships that have been the backbone of our business. From our beginning
in art glass to pioneering numerous processes and systems that are now standards in architectural
glass, our business and success are built on collaboration, trust, and human connection.

# How Glass Speaks to Light^{™}

From the White House to the Burj Khalifa, from the U.S. to Sweden, Germany, and countries all
throughout the world, our glass plays an integral part in some of the most recognizable structures
ever built.

[ Explore projects ][166]

### Bendheim Glass Systems

Precision-engineered, proven, and easy to specify, our wide range of interior and exterior glass
systems offer flexibility and ease of installation for a variety of applications.

[ Explore glass systems ][167]

### Specialty Glass

Join the ranks of world-renowned architects, interior designers, and global brands who have worked
with us to create breathtaking, timeless expressions of beauty in glass.

## Visions Realized

You share your ideas and imagination. Together, with the help of our collaborative Design-Assist
process, we turn visions into reality… without compromise. Our only limitations are the laws of
physics.

1

### Design Assist & System Development

To support the design process, early collaboration and visualization help identify potential
challenges, optimize system details, and align design intent with project budgets.

2

### Design Assist & System Development

Provides access to specialized glass knowledge and systems, feasibility, and structural
considerations. Streamline fabrication, reduce costs, and enhance sustainability.

3

### Unique Facades

Create complex facade geometries on tighter budgets, add texture & depth to the facade.

4

### Ease of Installation

No holes through the glass. Compression fittings easily adjust to field conditions speeding the
construction schedule.

5

### Vision Through Custom Solutions

Bendheim’s ventilated glass facade systems protect structures and/or occupants from wind-driven
rain, snow, and ice, while maintaining natural ventilation and daylight advantages.

6

### Visions Realized

Our engineered glass systems provide safety with durable materials, while ensuring ease of
installation through innovative design. They offer aesthetic flexibility, are cost-effective, and
sustainable.

Since 1927, the Bendheim family name has been synonymous with glass innovation. Over time we have

# More time for life

Intuitive set-up, effortless quality, and reliable results - all from a Brother inkjet printer.

 

[Discover more][105]

# Managed Print Services

Makes printing simple for businesses.

[Find Out More][106]

## Important Information - Firmware Update

New firmware update for: 

HL-L2400DW, HL-L2400DWE, HL-L2445DW HL-L2447DW, DCP-L2620DW, DCP-L2627DW, DCP-L2627DWE,
DCP-L2627DWXL, DCP-L2660DW, DCP-L2665DW, MFC-L2800DW, MFC-L2827DW, MFC-L2827DWXL, MFC-L2860DW,
MFC-L2835DW, MFC-L2860DWE.

Available in the Downloads & Drivers section in the Support area. 

[Get the latest firmware][107]

EcoPro printer to the Brother Mobile Connect app]

# Brother EcoPro ink and toner subscription 


EcoPro ink and toner subscription makes printing completely hassle-free. You can add it to any
existing compatible Brother printer and enjoy automated supplies ordering.

**Save up to 76%* on printing costs with an Ecopro subscription plan.**

adhesive][82] manufacturing companies in the US, we solve unique application requirements through
personalized consultation, technical prowess, and consistently excellent manufacturing performance.

#### Labels and labeling services

# You name it, we label it.

For over 50 years, we’ve been labeling anything our customers bring us. Our labels stick to any
surface, withstand any environment, and scan flawlessly, every time. The result – identification
that offers perfect clarity and confidence. If there’s a way to label it, we’ll find it.

[ Explore our labels ][228]
[ Durable Labels that Perform ][229]

## Not all labels are created equal.

Whether you need printable blank labels or a more complex custom printed set, our labels are
engineered to survive the most extreme conditions. Say goodbye to labels that get lost, smudged, or
end up unscannable – no matter what, our labels always look like new.

#### ENGINEERED LABELS

## Durable, custom labels for critical applications.

We manufacture the most durable labels that stick to any surface and can perform in any environment.
From pressure-sensitive to thermal transfer and barcode integration, our engineered labels combine
material science and print expertise to meet the highest demands in identification and traceability.

### [ Adhesive Labels. ][230]


##### Durable pressure-sensitive labels.

Built for harsh environments with engineered adhesives and materials that maintain clarity,
adhesion, and integrity.

Pressure sensitive labels deliver long-lasting performance through precision-engineered materials
and adhesives. Each construction balances strength, flexibility, and compatibility for consistent
results

#### Labels and labeling services

# You name it, we label it.

For over 50 years, we’ve been labeling anything our customers bring us. Our labels stick to any
surface, withstand any environment, and scan flawlessly, every time. The result – identification
that offers perfect clarity and confidence. If there’s a way to label it, we’ll find it.

[ Explore our labels ][228]
[ Durable Labels that Perform ][229]

## Not all labels are created equal.

Whether you need printable blank labels or a more complex custom printed set, our labels are
engineered to survive the most extreme conditions. Say goodbye to labels that get lost, smudged, or
end up unscannable – no matter what, our labels always look like new.

#### ENGINEERED LABELS

## Durable, custom labels for critical applications.

We manufacture the most durable labels that stick to any surface and can perform in any environment.
From pressure-sensitive to thermal transfer and barcode integration, our engineered labels combine
material science and print expertise to meet the highest demands in identification and traceability.

### [ Adhesive Labels. ][230]


##### Durable pressure-sensitive labels.

Built for harsh environments with engineered adhesives and materials that maintain clarity,
adhesion, and integrity.

Pressure sensitive labels deliver long-lasting performance through precision-engineered materials
and adhesives. Each construction balances strength, flexibility, and compatibility for consistent
results

At GemmyLabel, we provide professional adhesive label solutions tailored to a wide range of
industries. Our custom labels are crafted with high-quality materials and innovative designs,
helping clients enhance their brand image and improve management efficiency. Explore more below.

We provide precise and secure adhesive labels for medical institutions, ensuring clear product
information and easy traceability.

Our warehousing label solutions use custom adhesive labels to achieve accurate inventory management
and efficient logistics tracking, optimizing warehouse operations and reducing costs.

Our durable adhesive labels are specifically designed for the food and beverage industry, ensuring
clear product information, anti-counterfeiting, and compliance with food safety standards, enhancing
brand credibility.

identification, production process monitoring, and quality management, ensuring transparent product
information and seamless traceability.

assets and teaching equipment, improving information delivery and resource allocation.

logistics security, helping businesses optimize supply chain management and transportation
efficiency.

through adhesive labels that enable information management and improve customer experience.

Adhesive labels tailored for alcoholic products, helping brands showcase their uniqueness and meet
packaging compliance, boosting market competitiveness.

### [ Construction ][315]

Adhesive labels specifically for construction projects, ensuring clear identification of on-site
equipment, materials, and safety instructions, providing efficient and durable solutions.

# Make More From Your Music

Label Engine empowers thousands of labels and distributors to maximize their earnings and increase
their global footprint.
* Distribute your music to hundreds of stores worldwide
* Stress-free point-and-click royalty management
* Reach millions of new listeners
* Discover your next big act
* The best support worldwide

### 1 . Distribution

Upload your music instantly to Apple Music, Spotify, Beatport, iTunes, Amazon, TikTok, YouTube, and
hundreds of other digital stores and applications.

### 2 . Accounting

Fast, easy and hassle free! Label Engine's accounting & royalty processing system lets you process
statements and pay your artists within seconds, not hours.

[ Learn more ][21]
[Promotion]

### 3 . Promotion

Get your music heard! Label Engine's easy-to-use promotional tools get your tracks to the people
that matter most.

[ Learn more ][22]
[Demo Management]

### 4 . Demo Management

Find the next big hit! Get all your artist demos in one place, accept and reject tracks in seconds
with our instant communication tools.

[ Learn more ][23]

### What People are Saying About Us

A platform like Label Engine makes everything really accessible, simple and easy to use, even for
somebody with no music industry knowledge. Label Engine helps narrow down our accounting,
distribution and promotion processes all the information is really well done.

#### - Kannibalen Records

[Kannibalen Records]

We’ve grown a lot over the last few years as a music group and Label Engine is an important part of
our success at Insomniac Music Group. They earned our trust through consistency and transparency as
we grew our business from one label to now over twenty imprints. Label Engine helps us streamline
our operations because we no longer have to worry about the smallest details. They really care and
go above and beyond to make sure any of our requests are taken care of.

#### - Insomniac Music Group

[Insomniac Music Group]

Label Engine has been a game changer for us at Disciple!

Administration work is fun, quick and easy - we are able to streamline our processes to focus on
growing our business.

[[Sketch of the Labelary online ZPL viewer screen]][12]

## [LABEL VIEWER][13]

Easy-to-use online ZPL viewer. Useful for viewing and designing labels, tweaking ZPL code, and
converting ZPL labels to PNG or PDF files.

[[Sketch of different clients accessing the Labelary API]][14]

## [LABEL API][15]

Access to the Labelary ZPL engine via a simple RESTful API. Automate ZPL rendering and conversion
from within your own software.

[[Sketch of the Labelary logo]][16]

## [FAQ][17]

Do you have questions not answered in the [API documentation][18] or in the [Labelary engine
documentation][19]? Check our [frequently asked questions][20]!

[[Sketch of a school blackboard]][21]

## [ZPL INTRO][22]

Need to learn the basics of the ZPL print language, or refresh your memory? This introduction will
get you up and running in no time.

[[Sketch of a barcode generator]][23]

## [BARCODE GENERATOR][24]

Use our advanced [online barcode generator][25] to create barcodes and explore different types of
symbologies. Supports QR Code, Data Matrix, Code 128, Code 39, PDF417, MaxiCode, EAN, UPC and many
more.

[[Sketch of different systems accessing the Labelary Barcode API]][26]

## [BARCODE API][27]

Access the Labelary barcode engine via a simple RESTful API. Add barcodes to your own systems and
processes, with no extra software installation or maintenance required.

You deserve a partner who makes it easy to meet your goals. Good news—you just found one. At Meyers,
we’re dedicated to creating a sustainable future for people, products, and our planet. We believe
that great packaging is a powerful, yet humble tool that enhances our daily lives, introduces us to
our favorite new foods, and inspires unforgettable adventures.

We make that happen by creating sustainable packaging, and labels. And it takes a special group to
deliver such a tall order. Our team is a collection of hard-working, caring problem solvers who
enable innovative brand leaders. Join us, great things lie ahead!

### Our Solutions

From high-impact folding cartons to cutting-edge RFID, our solutions are
engineered for results.

Premium folding cartons and carton packaging built for retail success. Custom, sustainable
paperboard boxes to help brands deliver standout results.

sustainable, retail-ready packaging options.

[[Folding Cartons]][28]

IRCs and on-pack coupons that increase sales at retail. Proven strategies for effective promotions
that drive shopper engagement and loyalty.

[[Folding Cartons]][30]

Conductive ink printing for high-volume production. Roll-to-roll expertise and engineering support
trusted by aerospace, medical, and electronics brands.

[Packaging][32]

[Product Labels][33]

We’re a third generation family business that’s large enough to deliver and small enough to care. We
print tens of millions of pieces per year for Microsoft and just a few thousand for growing brands.
No matter your size, our partnership will mean a lot to Meyers, and you’ll feel that every day.

[LEARN MORE][34]

### ****Gurus of Products & Planet****

How do the best brands become sustainability leaders? It starts with packaging and extends into your
supply chain, your impact data, and beyond. You need a partner with a wealth of experience and
knowledge about sustainable packaging and manufacturing. Forget the companies just joining the
sustainability party now, you’ve found your guru.

[LEARN MORE][35]

### ****Awesome Meets Easy****

Very few shoppers understand how much effort goes into creating the product packaging and labels
found on store shelves.

## [The Best Pressure Sensitive Label Materials for Food and Beauty Packaging][45]

July 15, 2026
Not all pressure sensitive label materials are designed for the same environment. Food packaging
often requires moisture resistance, cold-temperature performance, and cost efficiency, while beauty
packaging demands durability, premium aesthetics, and resistance to oils and chemicals. This guide
compares the most common label materials used in food and beauty packaging, helping brands choose
the right solution based on product requirements, sustainability goals, and shelf impact.
[LEARN MORE >> The Best Pressure Sensitive Label Materials for Food and Beauty Packaging][46]
[[folding carton supplier]][47]

## [How to Choose the Right Paperboard Grade for Folding Cartons][48]

July 1, 2026
Selecting the right paperboard is one of the most important decisions in folding carton packaging.
The material you choose affects everything from shelf appeal and print quality to sustainability
performance and packaging costs. In this guide, you'll learn how SBS, CRB, URB, and FSC® and
SFI®-certified paperboard options compare, helping you choose the best folding carton material for
your product, brand goals, and supply chain requirements.
[LEARN MORE >> How to Choose the Right Paperboard Grade for Folding Cartons][49]

## [Pressure Sensitive Labels for Complex CPG SKUs][50]

June 24, 2026
Pressure-sensitive labels help CPG brands simplify packaging updates, launch new SKUs faster, and
manage multiple product versions with less inventory. For operations teams, that means fewer
disruptions. For brand teams, it means stronger shelf presence. For procurement teams, it means a
scalable packaging program that supports growth.
[LEARN MORE >> Pressure Sensitive Labels for Complex CPG SKUs][51]

## Certifications & Accreditations

[ecovadis-certification]

The EcoVadis Bronze certification is a rating awarded to companies that rank within the top 35% of
all companies for their overall sustainability performance. It indicates a strong awareness of
social and environmental impacts, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a structured approach
to sustainability management across environmental, labor, ethics, and sustainable procurement
criteria. 

A Sustainable Green Printing Partnership (SGP) certification is a comprehensive, third-party
validation for print and packaging facilities that meet high environmental standards and demonstrate
best practices for sustainability across their entire operations. This certification involves a
comprehensive audit to ensure a facility reduces waste and energy consumption, transitions to
sustainable materials, creates safer workplaces, and maintains a strong sustainability management
system.

The Great Printer Environmental Initiative Program recognizes printers who exceed required mandates
in compliance with all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) rules, regulations, and laws. Great
Printers demonstrate their commitment to minimizing their impact on human health and the environment
while producing quality printed products.

### More Than a Printer


You deserve a partner who makes it easy to meet your goals. Good news—you just found one. At Meyers,
we’re dedicated to creating a sustainable future for people, products, and our planet. We believe
that great packaging is a powerful, yet humble tool that enhances our daily lives, introduces us to
our favorite new foods, and inspires unforgettable adventures.

We make that happen by creating sustainable packaging, and labels. And it takes a special group to
deliver such a tall order. Our team is a collection of hard-working, caring problem solvers who
enable innovative brand leaders. Join us, great things lie ahead!

### Our Solutions

From high-impact folding cartons to cutting-edge RFID, our solutions are
engineered for results.

[[Folding Cartons]][20]

##### [Folding Cartons][21]

Premium folding cartons and carton packaging built for retail success. Custom, sustainable
paperboard boxes to help brands deliver standout results.

[[Folding Cartons]][22]

##### [RFID Solutions][23]

More than a plain RFID label. We embed custom RFID into packaging, labels, and backer cards, even
complex, out-of-the-ordinary solutions.

[[Folding Cartons]][24]

##### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][25]

Custom pressure sensitive labels backed by expert guidance. Our label specialists help brands solve
even the most challenging packaging needs.

[[Folding Cartons]][26]

##### [Packaging][27]

Packaging solutions from folding cartons to labels. Help your brand stand out with high-impact,
sustainable, retail-ready packaging options.

[[Folding Cartons]][28]

##### [Instant Redeemable Coupons (IRCs)][29]

IRCs and on-pack coupons that increase sales at retail. Proven strategies for effective promotions
that drive shopper engagement and loyalty.

[[Folding Cartons]][30]

##### [Conductive Ink Printer][31]

Conductive ink printing for high-volume production. Roll-to-roll expertise and engineering support
trusted by aerospace, medical, and electronics brands.

[Packaging][32]

[Product Labels][33]

### **Like Goldilocks, Just the Right Size**

We’re a third generation family business that’s large enough to deliver and small enough to care. We
print tens of millions of pieces per year for Microsoft and just a few thousand for growing brands.
No matter your size, our partnership will mean a lot to Meyers, and you’ll feel that every day.

[LEARN MORE][34]

### ****Gurus of Products & Planet****

How do the best brands become sustainability leaders? It starts with packaging and extends into your
supply chain, your impact data, and beyond. You need a partner with a wealth of experience and
knowledge about sustainable packaging and manufacturing. Forget the companies just joining the
sustainability party now, you’ve found your guru.

[LEARN MORE][35]

### ****Awesome Meets Easy****

Very few shoppers understand how much effort goes into creating the product packaging and labels
found on store shelves.

printing, packaging, and sustainability together!

[[Pressure-sensitive label applications]][44]

## [The Best Pressure Sensitive Label Materials for Food and Beauty Packaging][45]

July 15, 2026
Not all pressure sensitive label materials are designed for the same environment. Food packaging
often requires moisture resistance, cold-temperature performance, and cost efficiency, while beauty
packaging demands durability, premium aesthetics, and resistance to oils and chemicals. This guide
compares the most common label materials used in food and beauty packaging, helping brands choose
the right solution based on product requirements, sustainability goals, and shelf impact.
[LEARN MORE >> The Best Pressure Sensitive Label Materials for Food and Beauty Packaging][46]
[[folding carton supplier]][47]

## [How to Choose the Right Paperboard Grade for Folding Cartons][48]

July 1, 2026
Selecting the right paperboard is one of the most important decisions in folding carton packaging.
The material you choose affects everything from shelf appeal and print quality to sustainability
performance and packaging costs. In this guide, you'll learn how SBS, CRB, URB, and FSC® and
SFI®-certified paperboard options compare, helping you choose the best folding carton material for
your product, brand goals, and supply chain requirements.
[LEARN MORE >> How to Choose the Right Paperboard Grade for Folding Cartons][49]

## [Pressure Sensitive Labels for Complex CPG SKUs][50]

June 24, 2026
Pressure-sensitive labels help CPG brands simplify packaging updates, launch new SKUs faster, and
manage multiple product versions with less inventory. For operations teams, that means fewer
disruptions. For brand teams, it means stronger shelf presence. For procurement teams, it means a
scalable packaging program that supports growth.
[LEARN MORE >> Pressure Sensitive Labels for Complex CPG SKUs][51]

## Certifications & Accreditations

[ecovadis-certification]

The EcoVadis Bronze certification is a rating awarded to companies that rank within the top 35% of
all companies for their overall sustainability performance. It indicates a strong awareness of
social and environmental impacts, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a structured approach
to sustainability management across environmental, labor, ethics, and sustainable procurement
criteria. 

A Sustainable Green Printing Partnership (SGP) certification is a comprehensive, third-party
validation for print and packaging facilities that meet high environmental standards and demonstrate
best practices for sustainability across their entire operations. This certification involves a
comprehensive audit to ensure a facility reduces waste and energy consumption, transitions to
sustainable materials, creates safer workplaces, and maintains a strong sustainability management
system.

The Great Printer Environmental Initiative Program recognizes printers who exceed required mandates
in compliance with all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) rules, regulations, and laws. Great
Printers demonstrate their commitment to minimizing their impact on human health and the environment
while producing quality printed products.

# Custom Label Manufacturing
# QR Codes • Variable Data • Sticker Sheets

Welcome to Midwest Label Supply! We are a custom digital printer and convertor of labels with
software automation in our DNA. Our sweet spot is custom [variable data printing][34] of
individualized [serialized QR code labels][35], [Data Matrix codes][36], 2D barcodes and other smart
labels. Whether you need serialized QR labels for product authentication or an [API-connected direct
mail printer][37] that triggers from your CRM, we handle it. Midwest Label Supply prints
high-quality, custom, [pressure-sensitive labels][38] for a variety of technical applications.

## Serialized QR Code Labels & Variable Data Printing

Our specialty in [serialized QR code labels][39] and [variable data printing][40] enables unique
serialization for product tracking and customer engagement. Each serialized QR label gets its own
unique code, so you can track individual items from production line to end consumer. Our [variable
data label printer technology][41] provides cutting-edge solutions for modern businesses. Recent
enhancements in [QR Code Labels][42], [Data Matrix Labels][43], NFC Chips and RFID tags provide
opportunities for advances in tracking, individualization and serialization of products and
processes. We work with CPG companies to manufacture beautiful labels while eliminating supply chain
difficulties through product lifecycle tracking. Our digital printing process enables small runs
with variable content information (text, images, codes, UIDs) for enhanced customer experiences.

## Custom Sticker Sheets & On-Demand Fulfillment

Our [on-demand digital printing][44], die cutting and custom sticker sheet production, paired with
packaging services allows us to provide direct fulfillment to customers across the US. From single
custom sticker sheets to large format [variable data label sheets][45], we handle everything from
design to delivery. Need to trigger print jobs programmatically? Our direct mail API printer
capabilities let you send orders straight from your ecommerce platform or CRM. We also help [foreign
companies save money on direct mail][46] by sending from within the US to avoid international post
restrictions and tariffs.

## Popular Label Solutions

#### [Short Run Labels][47]

NO minimum orders! Perfect for startups and small batches with fast turnaround.

#### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][48]

Self-adhesive labels in 50+ materials for automated and hand application.

#### [Custom Die Cutting][49]

Precision cutting for unique shapes and specialized applications.

#### [Milwaukee Label Printing][50]

Local Milwaukee service with same-day pickup available.

#### [Chicago Label Printing][51]

Next-day delivery to Chicagoland area businesses.

#### [Direct Mail API][52]

REST API, signed webhooks, and USPS Informed Visibility tracking. A Lob, PostGrid, and Postalytics
alternative.

Empowering Brands through Precision Printing: With decades of expertise in the printing industry,
Novelty Creations and Novelty Labels stand tall as premier printers and manufacturers of labels,
leaflets, and premium packaging materials in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, India. Our commitment to
excellence drives us to deliver top-tier offset and flexographic printing and converting services.
We cater to esteemed brands and packaging companies across sectors like cosmetics, personal care,
agrochemicals, and more. Experience unparalleled quality and innovation with Novelty Creations and
Novelty Labels.

To become a prominent leader of
high-quality printing services and build

solutions that meet their ever-evolving needs of packaging.

their expectations thereby delivering exceptional value.

## How an AI Music Video Generator Works

An AI music video generator takes an audio file as input and produces a synchronized visual output —
a complete music video — without any manual filming or editing. The process starts with audio
analysis: the AI examines waveform data, detects beats and tempo changes, identifies vocal segments,
and interprets the emotional tone of the track. Essentially, it works as a [song-to-video AI][40]
pipeline that turns any track into a visual experience.

Next, the generator selects and composes visual elements. Depending on the chosen style, it may
render 3D environments, animate characters, compose abstract visual patterns, or assemble cinematic
footage — all timed to the rhythm and energy of the music. Transitions land on beat drops, scene
changes follow verse-chorus structures, and visual intensity mirrors the dynamics of the audio.

The technology behind modern generators draws on diffusion models, neural rendering, and temporal
coherence algorithms that ensure frame-to-frame consistency. Whether you start from a finished
master or a raw [audio-to-video AI][41] conversion, you get smooth, professional-looking footage
rather than a slideshow of disconnected images. The result is a deployable music video ready for
YouTube, social platforms, or streaming services — see how One More Shot AI compares in our [best AI
music video generator][42] guide.

## The Fastest AI Music Video Maker for Every Genre

Most artists call the same tool a different name — AI music video generator, AI music video maker,
AI music video creator — because the goal is the same: take a song and ship a finished video without
renting a studio. One More Shot AI is built for all three audiences. It is a fully automated AI
music video maker for artists who want one click between upload and download, and a scene-by-scene
AI music video creator for directors who want hands-on control over every cut, character, and color
palette.

For most users, the workflow is three steps. Drop in your audio (MP3, WAV, FLAC, or a Suno or Udio
link), pick a visual style — cinematic, anime, 3D, watercolor, retro VHS, abstract — and click
generate. The AI handles tempo detection, scene composition, transitions, color grading, and
optional lip-sync. A standard three-minute track renders in two to five minutes. Power users can
switch into Project Mode to override the AI on any scene, blend styles between verse and chorus, or
assign characters with reference images.

## Create AI Music Videos for Any Platform

A modern release lives on more than one screen. The generator exports landscape 16:9 videos for
YouTube, vertical 9:16 clips for [TikTok][43] and Instagram Reels, square 1:1 for the feed, and
short looping cuts sized for Spotify Canvas — all from a single source render. Output is up to 4K,
watermark-free on paid plans, and royalty-free on the visual side, so you can publish straight to
[YouTube][44], Spotify Canvas, TikTok, Instagram, and any other platform that accepts video.

Whether you produce on [Suno][45], on [Udio][46], in Ableton, in FL Studio, or you are recording
your own vocals, One More Shot AI meets your music where it already is — no format conversion, no
preprocessing, no friction. Try the [free AI music video generator][47] tier to make your first
video without a credit card, or jump straight into the full creator with the [AI music video
app][48] on any device.

## How an AI Music Video Generator Works

An AI music video generator takes an audio file as input and produces a synchronized visual output —
a complete music video — without any manual filming or editing. The process starts with audio
analysis: the AI examines waveform data, detects beats and tempo changes, identifies vocal segments,
and interprets the emotional tone of the track. Essentially, it works as a [song-to-video AI][40]
pipeline that turns any track into a visual experience.

Next, the generator selects and composes visual elements. Depending on the chosen style, it may
render 3D environments, animate characters, compose abstract visual patterns, or assemble cinematic
footage — all timed to the rhythm and energy of the music. Transitions land on beat drops, scene
changes follow verse-chorus structures, and visual intensity mirrors the dynamics of the audio.

The technology behind modern generators draws on diffusion models, neural rendering, and temporal
coherence algorithms that ensure frame-to-frame consistency. Whether you start from a finished
master or a raw [audio-to-video AI][41] conversion, you get smooth, professional-looking footage
rather than a slideshow of disconnected images. The result is a deployable music video ready for
YouTube, social platforms, or streaming services — see how One More Shot AI compares in our [best AI
music video generator][42] guide.

## The Fastest AI Music Video Maker for Every Genre

Most artists call the same tool a different name — AI music video generator, AI music video maker,
AI music video creator — because the goal is the same: take a song and ship a finished video without
renting a studio. One More Shot AI is built for all three audiences. It is a fully automated AI
music video maker for artists who want one click between upload and download, and a scene-by-scene
AI music video creator for directors who want hands-on control over every cut, character, and color
palette.

For most users, the workflow is three steps. Drop in your audio (MP3, WAV, FLAC, or a Suno or Udio
link), pick a visual style — cinematic, anime, 3D, watercolor, retro VHS, abstract — and click
generate. The AI handles tempo detection, scene composition, transitions, color grading, and
optional lip-sync. A standard three-minute track renders in two to five minutes. Power users can
switch into Project Mode to override the AI on any scene, blend styles between verse and chorus, or
assign characters with reference images.

## Create AI Music Videos for Any Platform

A modern release lives on more than one screen. The generator exports landscape 16:9 videos for
YouTube, vertical 9:16 clips for [TikTok][43] and Instagram Reels, square 1:1 for the feed, and
short looping cuts sized for Spotify Canvas — all from a single source render. Output is up to 4K,
watermark-free on paid plans, and royalty-free on the visual side, so you can publish straight to
[YouTube][44], Spotify Canvas, TikTok, Instagram, and any other platform that accepts video.

Whether you produce on [Suno][45], on [Udio][46], in Ableton, in FL Studio, or you are recording
your own vocals, One More Shot AI meets your music where it already is — no format conversion, no
preprocessing, no friction. Try the [free AI music video generator][47] tier to make your first
video without a credit card, or jump straight into the full creator with the [AI music video
app][48] on any device.

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about creating AI music videos.

### What is an AI music video generator?

An AI music video generator is a tool that uses artificial intelligence to automatically create
professional music videos from your audio tracks. It analyzes your music and generates synchronized
visuals, effects, and animations that match the rhythm, mood, and style of your song.

### How long does it take to generate a music video?

Most music videos are generated in just 2-5 minutes, depending on the length of your track and the
complexity of the visuals you choose.

### What video formats can I export?

You can export in multiple formats including HD 1080p for YouTube, vertical format for TikTok and
Instagram Reels, and square format for social media posts.

### Do I need video editing experience?

No experience needed! Simply upload your music, choose your style preferences, and let the AI handle
all the complex video creation and editing automatically.

### What audio formats are supported?

We support all major audio formats including MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, and OGG. You can also paste a link
to your track from platforms like Suno, Udio, or YouTube.

## HOW DO I USE ASSET LABELS

Application of asset labels will vary slightly between different label types.

Generally speaking, you will first need to find the best place on your item to locate the label –
easy to view or access with a barcode scanner. It is very important to ensure that the surface of
the chosen area is clean and free from grease, dirt and cleaning agents.

Then, simply peel off the backing and apply - taking particular care if the label is tamper
resistant. The glue on the label will be fully cured after around 48 hours.
* [image description]
* [image description]
* [image description]

## WHICH LABEL WILL SUIT ME

Browse our list of [Labels][19] today and see benefits and features of each. Once you have decided
which will best suit your needs, use our [ Label Maker][20] to create your design.

## WHICH ITEMS CAN I MARK

When it comes to choosing which items to protect with the use of asset tags, it is prudent to take a
common sense approach and carefully consider which equipment is most likely to be stolen and which
has the most the most tangible value. There are a great many objects which can be stolen from a
business premises but by carefully deploying asset tags throughout your premises, you will be able
to significantly reduce the likelihood that your property will be affected by thieves. Asset tags
are a very well crafted response to the threat of theft of burglary in business or residential
premises as they not only act as a deterrent to those thinking of stealing your property but can
also help in the recovery of property that has been stolen as they make a mark on stolen goods if
anyone endeavour to remove the asset tags from the piece of property. By know what to and what not
to tag, you will heighten the effectiveness of your asset tags.
* [image description]
* [image description]
* [image description]

## WHAT NOT TO MARK

Not only items found in a work type environment are suitable for use with asset tags. For example,
it is, of course, nonsensical to place asset tags on consumable products, or utterly immovable
objects. It is also unwise to place asset tags on items like antiques because it may adversely
affect the value of the piece even if it does prevent it from being stolen.

## TAKING STOCK

Asset tags are, of course, first and foremost a theft deterrent but they also have another important
use when it comes to the application of asset tags in a warehouse style environment. Asset tags have
also prove eminently efficient as a means of taking stock of your products and keeping track of
their location at all times. This is obviously an important feature of asset tags which merely adds
to its gravitas as an anti-theft device. Any one who steals an item that is fitted with asset tags
will find it to be a fruitless endeavour because asset tags not only make it nigh on impossible to
shift stolen goods, they also assist in the location and recovery of stolen property. The way in
which asset tags work is very well implemented to ensure that their mere presence is often
sufficient to act as a deterrent to theft but, on top of this, it is the stock monitoring
capabilities of asset tags that prove the biggest draw for many companies.
* [image description]
* [image description]
* [image description]

## ACCURACY

Asset tags are an extremely viable and accurate means of keeping tabs on all of your stock items to
ensure that none of it goes missing and that you’ll be able to locate it if it does. It is important
to choose the right sort of asset tags for your inventory to ensure that it operates optimally. For
example, if your stock is kept outside for the most part, you will need to choose a form of asset
tags which are more suited to these sorts of conditions than would be the case if your stock was
stored in an indoor environment.

# ASSET LABELs

**Mark Your Assets**

Mark your items with [SelectaLabel Asset Labels][11] and make them less attractive to thieves.

[DESIGN & ORDER YOURS][12]
 
[image description]

## LATEST TECHNOLOGY

Browse our range of [Barcode Scanners][13] to track and manage your assets

[image description] [image description]

## DESIGN YOURS NOW

[image description] [image description]

## SPECIALIST LABELS

With years of experience we can also help with your [bespoke label requirements][15].
* [How easy is it to apply?][16]
* [What products can I use it on?][17]
* [How can I manage my assets?][18]

## HOW DO I USE ASSET LABELS

Application of asset labels will vary slightly between different label types.

Generally speaking, you will first need to find the best place on your item to locate the label –
easy to view or access with a barcode scanner. It is very important to ensure that the surface of
the chosen area is clean and free from grease, dirt and cleaning agents.

Then, simply peel off the backing and apply - taking particular care if the label is tamper
resistant. The glue on the label will be fully cured after around 48 hours.
* [image description]
* [image description]
* [image description]

## WHICH LABEL WILL SUIT ME

Browse our list of [Labels][19] today and see benefits and features of each. Once you have decided
which will best suit your needs, use our [ Label Maker][20] to create your design.

## WHICH ITEMS CAN I MARK

When it comes to choosing which items to protect with the use of asset tags, it is prudent to take a
common sense approach and carefully consider which equipment is most likely to be stolen and which
has the most the most tangible value. There are a great many objects which can be stolen from a
business premises but by carefully deploying asset tags throughout your premises, you will be able
to significantly reduce the likelihood that your property will be affected by thieves. Asset tags
are a very well crafted response to the threat of theft of burglary in business or residential
premises as they not only act as a deterrent to those thinking of stealing your property but can
also help in the recovery of property that has been stolen as they make a mark on stolen goods if
anyone endeavour to remove the asset tags from the piece of property. By know what to and what not
to tag, you will heighten the effectiveness of your asset tags.
* [image description]
* [image description]
* [image description]

## WHAT NOT TO MARK

Not only items found in a work type environment are suitable for use with asset tags. For example,
it is, of course, nonsensical to place asset tags on consumable products, or utterly immovable
objects. It is also unwise to place asset tags on items like antiques because it may adversely
affect the value of the piece even if it does prevent it from being stolen.

## TAKING STOCK

Asset tags are, of course, first and foremost a theft deterrent but they also have another important
use when it comes to the application of asset tags in a warehouse style environment. Asset tags have
also prove eminently efficient as a means of taking stock of your products and keeping track of
their location at all times. This is obviously an important feature of asset tags which merely adds
to its gravitas as an anti-theft device. Any one who steals an item that is fitted with asset tags
will find it to be a fruitless endeavour because asset tags not only make it nigh on impossible to
shift stolen goods, they also assist in the location and recovery of stolen property. The way in
which asset tags work is very well implemented to ensure that their mere presence is often
sufficient to act as a deterrent to theft but, on top of this, it is the stock monitoring
capabilities of asset tags that prove the biggest draw for many companies.
* [image description]
* [image description]
* [image description]

## ACCURACY

Asset tags are an extremely viable and accurate means of keeping tabs on all of your stock items to
ensure that none of it goes missing and that you’ll be able to locate it if it does. It is important
to choose the right sort of asset tags for your inventory to ensure that it operates optimally. For
example, if your stock is kept outside for the most part, you will need to choose a form of asset
tags which are more suited to these sorts of conditions than would be the case if your stock was
stored in an indoor environment.

## Stickers, labels & decals: what’s the difference?

Nothing. Technically, these terms are all completely interchangeable. They all refer to custom
adhesive-backed material pieces, usually printed.

However, the custom printing industry uses these general definitions for these adhesive-backed
products:
* Stickers: individually cut
* Labels: on rolls or on sheets
* Decals: larger pieces but still individually cut

If you want to custom make stickers, it’s best to keep these broad definitions in mind to get what
you want.

### How to find the right product for me

We’ve spent hundreds of hours creating lots of great custom resources online to help you choose the
best sticker for your application.

Watch this video for an overview of all the different custom stickers we print. Or [download our
free guide][48] to help choose the right printed stickers for your brand or project.

A good rule of thumb to remember is that custom-cut vinyl stickers are the perfect all-rounder.
Custom vinyl is waterproof and can be used indoors and outdoors for years. Check out more about how
to make stickers waterproof. On top of that, they are easy to remove and will not leave any residue
or damage your surface.

You prefer a real sticker sample you can have in your hand? We have two choices for you:
* Buy a $1 material sample pack that gives you an example of each material we use to produce custom
  stickers, helping you choose by seeing the quality of the sticker material before ordering. You
  can get your favourites custom printed.
* Get ten [custom printed samples][49] for only $9, with free delivery. Great if you want to see
  your exact logo or business sticker design or colours as a physical sticker before ordering a
  larger batch of custom stickers.
